summary:
**Worked:** Rommel's retreat from Alamein became the best card ever (Threads 3,210 views, Reach 8.36), with Manila Bay (3.47), the Fu-Go Spec Sheet (2.91), and the Spruce Goose (12 Threads comments) close behind. YouTube had its best week (9,241 views; Supercharge 2,610). Battle Lines cards out reaching Blueprint and Home Front is now a pattern, three reviews running.

**Didn't:** Threads cut the account's reach about 80 percent from 5 Nov (about 300 views a day since, against 1,400 to 3,500), so the late week cards (the FDR election posts, Torch, the Hitler quote) scored low for reasons outside the card. Facebook Reels went quiet again (four in a row near zero).

**Tests:** C (shorter Story Cards) is running, but no Story Card has been needed since it started; review 24 Nov. A and B closed and dropped, as you chose. No new test while Threads is disrupted.

**Decisions:** Name This on Instagram (asked again), and an optional Threads account status check. Your h-hollywood veto is applied.

questions.why: Asked again, as you wanted. Six Name This cards have drawn 13, 5, 4, 1, 8, and 6 Instagram views (typical 5.5), the same as Instagram cards (typical 7), and no follows. Claude's view: end it.
questions.if_yes: Name This posts go to X, Threads, and Facebook only, from the next Saturday Name This run.
questions.if_blank: Name This stays on Instagram and the question comes back next week.

questions.ask: Threads account status: what does the app show?
questions.why: From 5 Nov, Threads views fell about 80 percent on every post. In the Threads app open **Settings, Account, Account status** and see whether anything is flagged or limited. Optional, about two minutes.
options: Something is flagged or limited (I'll say what in the notes)
questions.if_yes: The next review reads the Threads numbers with that in mind.
questions.if_blank: Nothing changes; the drop stays under Watch.

questions.ask: Veto any of this week's new Code Room groups
questions.why: These 9 hard groups were added to the Code Room master list from posted cards (one short of 10). Veto any link you don't want dealt; vetoed groups are kept but never dealt and never added again.

groups.link: Each involves Admiral William F. Halsey.
Each took to the air built mostly of wood or paper.
Each involves the U.S. Navy confronting Germany before Pearl Harbor.
Each involves a man who would later become president of the United States.
All three took place in California.
In each, Hitler ordered his troops to hold their ground at all costs.
In each, an American general came ashore from the sea.
Each involves General George S. Patton.
Each involves the U.S. 1st Infantry Division.

questions.why: Anything you saw in the apps this week.
